items.period: Seal-script form as transmitted in the Shuowen tradition; modern vector illustration uploaded 2014
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 零 in the seal-script style associated with Shuowen; it shows the traditional 雨 and 令 components, not an excavated inscription.
items.alt: Monochrome outlined seal-script character 零, digitally redrawn.
items.selection_reason: Provides a reusable illustration of the dictionary-preserved seal form and the two components central to the supported analysis. It is not evidence for an oracle-bone form or an artifact’s date.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons page states the vector representation is public domain; the description also notes courtesy/permission associated with the cited Sears source. Treat as a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The proposed seal glyph is a modern digital vector redraw of a received script form, not a photograph or facsimile of an excavated ancient inscription.
No Xiaoxuetang 零 image is proposed because no exact character-specific record or rendered glyph URL could be retrieved, despite the database's stated CC0 terms for queried glyph images.
